blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers.

Today's lesson is "What Is Accounting?". It gives you short, practical sentences. You can use them with the finance team. You also learn the verb to be — am, is, are.

Go slowly. One step at a time. You can do it!

items.q: What is the lesson about?
items.why: "Today's lesson is 'What Is Accounting?'."

items.q: Who can you use these sentences with?
items.why: "You can use them with the finance team."

items.q: The sentences in this lesson are…
items.why: "It gives you short, practical sentences."

items.q: "One step at a time" suggests that the writer wants you to…
options: not learn the verb to be
items.why: Inferência: "Go slowly. One step at a time." — a ideia é calma, um passo por vez.

items.q: The writer would most likely AGREE that…
options: the finance team is not important
you can learn this, one step at a time
English is too difficult to try
accounting has nothing to do with numbers
items.why: Inferência: "English comes in CAN's… You can do it!" — o tom é encorajador.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentar o tema a uma nova estagiária. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the accounting team. I'm Sophie. Today is your first day, so let's start slowly. Take a seat. Here is your desk.

Accounting is easy to understand. It is about numbers. It is about money. Every day, we look at the numbers and we write a report. The report is short. It is honest. It is clear. That is our job.

Here is a simple word: balance. The balance is the money we have. I check the balance every morning. You can help me with it. It is not hard.

Now, listen to me. This is your first lesson. You are ready. You are here, and you want to learn. That is very good!

Don't worry about mistakes. Mistakes are normal. One step at a time. Repeat after me: "I am ready." Good! Say it again: "The report is clear." Perfect. You are a fast learner.

Tomorrow, we look at a new number together. It is a small team, but we are friendly. Any question is a good question. You can do it. Welcome again!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking, and to whom?
options: A teacher, to a class of children
items.why: "Welcome to the accounting team. I'm Sophie… your first day."

items.q: What does the team do every day?
options: They look at the numbers and write a report
items.why: "Every day, we look at the numbers and we write a report."

items.q: What is the balance?
items.why: "The balance is the money we have."

items.q: What does Sophie mean by "Don't worry about mistakes"?
options: It is okay to make mistakes while you learn
items.why: Inferência: "Mistakes are normal. One step at a time." — errar faz parte de aprender.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela elogia, diz "You can do it" e pede calma — tom acolhedor.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I work in the accounting team." Accounting is…
items.why: Accounting = contabilidade.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is a new ___ to review this week: it is 4,500."
items.why: Number = número; 4,500 é um número.

items.q: "The money is ready for your signature." Money is…
items.why: Money = dinheiro.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We check the ___ at the end of every day. It is short and clear."
items.why: Report = relatório; é curto e claro, e é checado no fim do dia.

items.q: "Please leave the balance on my desk." The balance is…
items.why: Balance = saldo, o dinheiro que temos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o "ok" final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new report next week." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = colocar em uso, lançar.

items.q: "Let's check in tomorrow morning." To check in means to…
options: talk to see how things are
items.why: Check in = dar um retorno rápido, ver como as coisas estão.

items.q: "Sophie says: 'Please follow through with the plan.'" To follow through means to…
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "Let's wrap up for today." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = encerrar, terminar.
